name: FeaturesTraits3
value: * Spell Mastery • PHB-2024 167 You’ve achieved such mastery over certain spells that you can cast at will. Choose a level 1 and level 2 spell in your spellbook that has a casting time of an action. You always have them prepared, and can cast them at their lowest level without expending a spell slot.
